parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests`) and verify different behavioural concerns — core state after stop vs. idempotent play-after-stop — making the structural overlap intentional rather than accidental. Merging or deduplicating test methods that assert different invariants would reduce test clarity and could mask regressions.
